android.desc:
Music Guesses — Sound & Picture Quiz 🎹🎵 · 100% free · no ads

Welcome to Music Guesses — a bright, ad-free quiz where you listen to a real instrument sound and decide if it matches the picture. Tap Play ▶️, use your ears, then tap True or False. Each round is a small listening puzzle — easy to follow, even for younger players with a grown-up nearby. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, and no ads — just the game.

How it works 🧠

Tap the blue Play button to hear the sound.
Look at the instrument picture.
Tap True if you think they go together, or False if you think they don’t match.
Earn stars for correct answers and try to finish the whole quiz.
Why kids & families like it 👨‍👩‍👧

Ad-free & free to play — no banners, no video ads, no interruptions.
Mostly picture + sound — you can play by listening and tapping; a little reading helps for the score line at the end.
Short rounds — nice for a quick break or a calm moment on the sofa.
Friendly look — big colorful buttons and a simple layout.
Encouraging feedback — stars and smiles when you get it right.
What you’ll practice 🌟

Listening carefully
Matching sounds and pictures
Choosing True or False
Remembering how different instruments can sound
Good to know for parents & teachers 📋

Calm, non-violent music game — no fighting, no scary scenes.
No chat in the app.
No account required in the app for normal play (your device or Google Play may still ask you to sign in to the store — that’s outside the app).
Great for quiet time, a music warm-up, or travel — use headphones at a comfortable volume for little ears.
Credits 🙏

Images: created with Nano Banana by Google Gemini.
Sounds: Freesound.
Technical (short) ⚙️
Android app; content is suitable for kids with supervision; very young children may need help reading the final score summary.
